jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:CPO; Chief-Product-Officer; Product OwnerStellenbeschreibung:About HeyGermanyGermany urgently needs international talent. Yet complex and lengthy recognition processes prevent many qualified professionals from working in the jobs they trained for. At the same time, employers struggle to fill critical positions.HeyGermany wants to change that. We are building the digital infrastructure to make professional recognition and work integration faster and easier. We are starting with nursing and plan to expand into other regulated professions. Our mission is to remove bureaucratic barriers and help international talent access jobs that match their qualifications.The RoleWe are looking for a hands-on, product-driven Founding CTPO with the ambition to build HeyGermany as a co-founder. You will take full ownership of both product and technology, from understanding customer problems and defining our product vision to building, launching and scaling the solutions.You will work closely with the Founder & CEO to shape company strategy, identify growth opportunities and turn our vision into a product that users love and businesses are willing to pay for.We already have a live MVP (www.hey-germany.com (http://www.hey-germany.com) ), an initial recognition engine and talent pool, 400+ talent pool conversions, our first enterprise pilot and secured public funding.Your challenge is to turn this foundation into a scalable, user-centric platform that can take HeyGermany from one profession to many, while building the product and technology capabilities to support long-term growth.What You’ll Do- Own our product vision, strategy and roadmap, translating customer needs, business goals and market insights into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.- Lead product discovery and development end-to-end, from user research, problem validation and prototyping to technical implementation, launch and iteration.- Own our technology strategy and architecture, building scalable systems for qualification recognition, document processing, workflow automation and talent matching.- Turn complex regulatory and bureaucratic processes into simple, intuitive digital experiences, with a strong focus on usability, customer value and conversion.- Stay hands-on in building the product, making key technical decisions across frontend, backend, APIs, data and cloud infrastructure while maintaining a high standard of product quality.- Identify and develop AI-powered product opportunities where they create real value, particularly in document analysis, structured data extraction, intelligent matching and workflow automation.- Work directly with international professionals, employers and domain experts to understand their needs, validate assumptions and continuously improve the product.- Define and track key product metrics, using data, user feedback and experimentation to drive product decisions, engagement, conversion and business outcomes.- Build and lead our future product and engineering team, establishing a strong culture of ownership, customer focus, speed and continuous learning.What We’re Looking For- We care less about your current title than about what you have built, your product judgment and the level of ownership you are ready to take.- 7+ years of experience in software engineering, product development or technical product leadership, with strong hands-on technical capabilities.- A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.- A proven track record of building and shipping digital products end-to-end, ideally in a founder, founding engineer, product-minded CTO, technical product lead or similar role.- Strong product thinking, with the ability to identify real customer problems, validate solutions, prioritize effectively and balance user needs with business impact and technical feasibility.- Strong experience with a modern web stack, ideally TypeScript, React/Next.js, backend development, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure.- Practical experience building with LLMs and modern AI systems, including RAG, agents and evaluations, and using AI effectively in product development and day-to-day work.- Experience with product discovery, user research, UX principles, product analytics and iterative development. You know how to move from an initial hypothesis to a product that delivers measurable value.- The ability to make pragmatic decisions across product and technology, balancing speed, user experience, quality and scalability in an early-stage environment.- A strong understanding of how product decisions connect to business outcomes, including acquisition, activation, retention and monetization.- A founder mindset and strong connection to our mission**.** You want real ownership, are comfortable with the ambiguity of a pre-seed company and care about building a successful business, not just great technology.- Strong English communication skills are required. German is a plus.- Experience with document intelligence/OCR, B2B SaaS, marketplaces, HR Tech, Global Mobility or regulated/GDPR-sensitive products is valuable, but not required.What We Offer- €50,000–€65,000 annual base salary, with salary growth as the company scales, plus meaningful equity reflecting the founder-level ownership of the role.- The opportunity to become a true co-founder, with long-term ownership of product and technology and meaningful participation in the company’s upside.- Founder-level influence over product vision, technology and company strategy, with the freedom to shape what we build, how we build it and how we grow.- The opportunity to build our product, technology architecture and future product and engineering organisation from the ground up.- A live product, early traction, our first enterprise pilot and secured public funding. We are currently in conversations with investors for our next stage of growth.- The opportunity to work on a problem with tangible social and economic impact: helping international professionals access jobs that match their qualifications while helping employers access talent they urgently need.We believe professional opportunities should be determined by people’s skills, not by their ability to navigate bureaucracy.If you want to build both the product and the technology behind a company from the ground up, take real ownership and help shape HeyGermany as a co-founder, we would love to hear from you.Send us one product you've built that you're proud of, tell us what role you played in bringing it to life, and why this mission matters to you.katharina@hey-germany.com (https://mailto:katharina@hey-germany.com)Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

Over the last 20 years the company has developed into a system house with its own product portfolios in the area of holistic, high quality information management, information logistics and process optimisation, security and cyber strategy and compliance/data protection consulting.The job is a Senior Container Administrator role.  The environment to be managed is an air-gapped on-prem solution.  The expectation is that the candidate will also perform Unix/Linux administration activities.The job is located in the north of Munich (on site as no remote working is possible).Tasks:- Deploy, configure, and maintain Rancher-based container platform in an air-gapped environment. - Manage Kubernetes clusters, nodes, and workloads within the Rancher ecosystem. - Administer Unix-based operating systems, including performance tuning and troubleshooting. - Implement security hardening practices for containerized environments and Unix servers. - Automate system and container operations using scripting languages such as Ansible. - Ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery for containerized workloads. - Design and implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions for both Rancher and Unix infrastructure. - Collaborate with DevOps and development teams to support CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows. - Maintain compliance with security policies, including patch management and vulnerability remediation. - Document architecture, procedures, and operational guidelines for system administration. Requirements/Knowledge/Experience:- Proven experience in Rancher container orchestration and Kubernetes administration. - Strong expertise in Unix/Linux system administration (RHEL8, RHEL9, or similar). - Knowledge of air-gapped deployments and best practices for secure environments. - Proficiency in infrastructure automation using Ansible, Terraform, or similar tools. - Hands-on experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Loki. - Strong troubleshooting and performance tuning skills for both containers and Unix systems. - Familiarity with container security tools and practices. - Experience working with containerized databases and persistent storage solutions.- Experience with version control and CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jenkins, ArgoCD, etc.). - Certifications such as CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator), RHCE (Red Hat Certified Engineer), or similar is an advantage.- Understanding of SIEM tools and security event monitoring focused on containers is an advantage. - Working with ticket system for incidents, problems, change management and configuration management.- Strong background in IT (working in IT).- IT related Bachelor or Master’s degree is a plus.- Any knowledge of ITIL would be useful.- Knowledge of DNS and load balancers.- Good Unix/Linux knowledge.- Knowledge of BMC Helix would be nice to have.- VMWare knowledge would be nice to have.- The candidate should also be able to speak and write in English.- Security check (Ü2) available or willing to go through the process to acquire it.- Willingness to learn and acquire new skills (including acquiring relevant certifications).Willingness to work in a rotation system (to cover the service hours) and to work outside working hours (usually one Saturday per month)Your Soft Skills:High team spiritReliability, punctualityOur offer:We offer a safe, trustful and long-term working environment with very good working conditions in an exciting working environmentCompany fitness and other company eventsClear and open internal communications and fast decisionsCultural and international mixture of leading experts in their areasHighly innovative environment with a personal development planWe look forward to welcoming you to our team and shaping the future.Contact person: Doris Böhner, d.boehner@dwh.gmbH (https://mailto:d.boehner@dwh.gmbH) , Phone 089 660393-17Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Betriebssystem Linux, Betriebssystem Linux Red Hat, Betriebssystem UNIX

jobs.description: - The Institute of Active Polymers at Helmholtz-Zentrum Hereon is seeking a Postdoctoral Researcher in Mechanobiology & Digital Twins for its activities in the field of stem cell modification and biomaterials at its Teltow site. The position is initially limited until 30 November 2028.Equal opportunity is an integral part of our personnel policy. The full-time position (39 hours per week) can, in principle, also be filled on a part-time basis.Your tasks:Scientific and methodological tasks:- design and perform mechanobiology experiments with primary T cells, B cells and/or other immune cells at engineered biomaterial interfaces- develop, optimize and apply advanced fluorescence and super-resolution microscopy to resolve receptor organization, close-contact formation, cytoskeletal architecture and signalling in living and fixed cells- establish and use biomaterial model systems, including nanostructured surfaces, hydrogels/​​viscoelastic materials and functionalized interfaces with controlled mechanics, topography and ligand presentation- build quantitative image-analysis workflows for large 2D/3D/4D microscopy data sets and extract spatial, dynamic and biophysical features at the single-cell and subcellular level- integrate imaging, mechanical and functional measurements into digital-twin models of immune-cell activation and cell-material interactions- develop, fit and validate mechanistic and data-driven models (e.g. ODE, agent-based, biophysical, statistical or machine-learning approaches as appropriate), including parameter inference and sensitivity analysis- use an iterative model-experiment cycle to generate testable predictions and experimentally validate and refine the digital twins- quantify immune-cell activation, signalling, morphology and function using complementary cellbiological and biophysical assays, including flow cytometry and live-cell measurements- cooperate closely with microscopy, materials-science, computational and immunology partners and contribute to shared experimental and data standards- prepare scientific publications, conference contributions, invention disclosures where relevant, and contribute to follow-up funding and grant applications- supervise MSc students and interns and contribute to the scientific mentoring of PhD studentsRelated tasks:- literature and data analysis in the relevant fields; documentation and reproducible/​FAIR management of imaging, analysis and modelling workflows- procurement of materials and consumables; participation in group, institute and project meetings, partner meetings, trainings and scientific networking activities- preparation and maintenance of experimental protocols, analysis code, model documentation, progress reports and training materialsYour profile:Education:- Doctoral degree (PhD/Dr.) in biophysics, physics, bioengineering/​biomedical engineering, materials science/​biomaterials, cell biology, immunology or a comparable fieldExpertise and experience:- strong hands-on expertise in at least one of the following areas: advanced fluorescence/​superresolution microscopy, quantitative bioimaging, mechanobiology or biomaterials; demonstrated ability and motivation to expand into the adjacent areas- experience with mammalian cell culture; experience with primary immune cells and immune-cell assays is highly desirable- experience with SMLM, SIM, STED, light-sheet or comparable advanced microscopy methods is desirable- knowledge of cell-material interfaces, hydrogels, nanostructured surfaces and/or mechano­transduction is advantageous- strong quantitative image-analysis skills and scientific programming experience (e.g. Python, MATLAB or R; Fiji/​lmageJ or comparable tools)- experience with mathematical modelling, machine learning or digital-twin approaches is an advantage; a strong interest in integrating experiments with predictive models is expected- demonstrated capacity for independent scientific work, publication of research results, interdisciplinary teamwork and clear scientific communication in EnglishOur offer:- an exciting and varied job in a research center with around 1,000 employees from more than 60 nations- an International Welcome Office with guest accommodation- 6 weeks holiday per year; company holidays between Christmas and New Year's Day- social benefits under the collective agreement for the German public sector and remuneration up to pay grade 13 (EntgO Bund)- very good work-life balance; options for mobile and flexible working- a well-connected research campus, good networking opportunities, a subsidized Deutschlandticket (job ticket) subject to certain conditions- individual opportunities for training and development- an excellent technical infrastructure and modern workplace equipment- a family-friendly working environment with childcare options, e.g. a parent-child room- workplace jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day You start your day by reviewing project progress, key milestones, risks, dependencies and open actions across strategic initiatives. Together with workstream leads and cross-functional teams, you align priorities, facilitate project meetings and ensure that decisions are translated into clear responsibilities and timelines. Throughout the day, you coordinate stakeholders, resolve implementation issues, update project plans and prepare concise status reports or decision papers for leadership. Your focus is on maintaining transparency, execution discipline and driving projects from planning through to measurable results. How You’ll Make an Impact * Management and implementation of strategic and cross-functional projects, including business initiatives, partnerships, transformation programs and continuous improvement activities* Translation of strategic priorities and management decisions into structured project scopes, workplans, milestones, responsibilities and deliverables* Establishment and maintenance of project governance frameworks, including meeting structures, reporting routines, decision processes and escalation mechanisms* Coordination of cross-functional teams and workstreams, facilitation of project meetings and follow-up on actions, commitments and deliverables* Monitoring of schedules, resources, dependencies, risks and issues, including initiation of corrective actions to ensure successful project execution* Preparation of project status reports, steering documents and decision papers for leadership, as well as support for strategic analyses and implementation-related concept workWhat You Bring* Master’s degree or equivalent in business administration, engineering, economics or another relevant discipline* Several years of experience in project management, PMO or implementation of cross-functional initiatives, ideally complemented by exposure to strategy, transformation or business development* Proven experience managing complex projects, including project setup, governance, scheduling, milestone tracking, stakeholder coordination, risk and issue management* Strong ability to translate strategic objectives into executable plans and successfully drive implementation across functions and international teams* Excellent project management, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder-management skills, combined with a structured, pragmatic and results-oriented working style* High level of ownership, reliability and persistence, confidence in working with senior stakeholders in a global organization, fluent business English and German as an advantageAbout the TeamOur Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. WHAT WE OFFER* Competitive compensation* Flexible working hours and working time accounts to support the work-life balance* Support your professional development through internal and external training and certification programs* Modern office building with an on-site canteen offering freshly cooked local dishes (with vegetarian option)* Attractive benefits (security, flexibility, support and well-being)* The office in Estenfeld is well connected to the transport network.
